title: John Glenn's 'fireflies' were ice crystals
summary: Michael Shermer tells of John Glenn's 'fireflies' were ice crystals, about 1962 at Earth orbit, Friendship 7, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: or like uh John Glenn, you know, with the the little ice crystals ice crystals.

plain: Michael Shermer, a researcher known for doubting UFO claims, brings up John Glenn on the podcast of host Jesse Michels. Glenn was an American astronaut who orbited Earth in 1962 in a capsule called Friendship 7 and spoke of seeing glowing "fireflies" outside. Shermer says these were little ice crystals, and he offers it as an example of a strange sight in space that turned out to have an ordinary cause.
